fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Image shown as the background of this slide. Recommended size: 1920x1080px.

fields.label: Tag Line
fields.description: Small line shown above the title (optional).

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Caption heading of the slide. HTML allowed, e.g. <em>text</em> for italic.

fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: Caption text under the title (optional). HTML allowed.

fields.label: Button Label
fields.description: Text on the call-to-action button, e.g. View Cruises. Empty = use the Default Button Label set in Travel Website.

fields.label: Button URL
fields.description: Where the button goes, e.g. /cruises. Leave empty to hide the button on this slide.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Untick to hide this slide without deleting it.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Slides are shown from the lowest number first.
